name: starlite
description: Lightweight VRM companions for web and desktop, with an optional Inochi2D backend

scripts.build: npm run fixtures && npm run build:wasm && npm run build --workspace @starcried/starlite-core && npm run build --workspace @starcried/starlite-inochi2d && npm run build --workspace @starcried/starlite-vrm && npm run build --workspace hexo-starlite && npm run build --workspace @starcried/starlite-vanilla-example && npm run build --workspace @starcried/starlite-hexo-example && npm run build --workspace @starcried/starlite-hexo-vrm-example
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.pack:release-check: npm run check:licenses && INOCHI2D_RELEASE_PACK=1 node tools/verify-package-contents.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:demo && npm run test:budgets && npm run test:dependency-audit
scripts.validate: npm run check:rust && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:runtime-budget && npm run check:licenses && npm run test && npm run pack:check
